messages:
maya: Alert from gcs-monitor — public ACL detected on object: gs://redwood-artifacts/deploy/sa-key.json :eyes:
maya: log snippet: `ACL: AllUsers:READER` — first seen 2026-11-02T14:03:05Z
eli: on it. can someone immediately remove public ACL and replace with project-private?
maya: running: `gsutil acl ch -d AllUsers gs://redwood-artifacts/deploy/sa-key.json`
ops-bot: gsutil operation completed — gs://redwood-artifacts/deploy/sa-key.json ACL updated (removed AllUsers) :white_check_mark:
sam: did anyone fetch that object while it was public? check storage access logs and access timestamps
maya: checked stackdriver access logs — last public GET at 2026-11-02T13:59:11Z from IP 203.0.113.45, user-agent: curl/7.79.1
carol: assume compromise until proven otherwise. rotate the service account key associated with that file, revoke old key, and audit where the key was used.
carol: commands: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account deploy-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account deploy-sa@...`
eli: I'll run the rotation now and create a new key for CI with short TTL. will also add conditional access so bucket objects cannot be public in future.
maya: created ticket INC-4521 in Jira: "public deploy key uploaded to artifacts bucket" and added initial timeline + logs
ir-bot: Incident checklist triggered — containment done (ACL removed). Recommended next steps: rotate keys, check audit logs, enable bucket policy/organization constraint, notify compliance.
sam: quick inventory — search recent commits and CI jobs that might have uploaded the file: `gsutil ls -l gs://redwood-artifacts/deploy/** | grep sa-key` and check CI logs in Buildkite job 2041
carol: add long-term mitigations: 1) enforce org policy to prevent public storage objects 2) enable uniform bucket-level access + deny public ACLs 3) integrate artifact uploads with KMS envelope encryption and store keys only in KMS, not as raw JSON 4) add CI pre-deploy hook to block uploading files matching `*-key.json`
eli: created terraform change: `google_storage_bucket_iam_configuration` update + org policy `constraints/storage.uniformBucketLevelAccess` — will open PR and link to INC-4521
maya: evidence: exported access log lines attached to Jira. so far only that single GET observed, unknown client.
sam: run grep across logs for the key ID to ensure it wasn’t reused: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.request.@type="type.googleapis.com/google.storage.v2.StorageObjectGet" AND "sa-key.json"' --limit 1000`
carol: compliance note — we need to notify data-protection team and record this in the audit log with actions taken (rotation, ACL removal, tickets). I'll draft a one-paragraph notification for legal
eli: action items assigned: rotate key (done), delete exposed key (done), open infra PR to block public ACLs (PR 789), enable CMEK for artifact buckets (WIP), add CI block (WIP).
maya: follow-up: schedule 72-hour monitoring window for anomalous usage, escalate to SRE if we see new unexpected traffic
sam: closing loop — will run broader scan across other artifact buckets for similar files and add findings to INC-4521
carol: post-incident: add automated detector to prevent uploads of private credentials (pre-commit hook + bucket object classifier), run runbook refresher with dev teams next week :calendar:
maya: thanks all. keeping channel updated in INC-4521. if we find more hits ping here. :lock:
__notes: Single-thread Slack export style JSON for a short incident triage on exposed GCS deploy credentials. Messages are chronological, short, include commands, bots and concrete remediation steps.
